entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit Customer Support. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Isaac, and you've reached VeloFit Support. How can I help you today?
Yeah, I want to return this VeloBand tracker. It's garbage and I want my money back. Now.
I can certainly look into that for you. To make sure I understand correctly, what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or a preference?
It's a preference! It's uncomfortable, the battery life is a joke, and I just don't want it. I'm not troubleshooting anything, I want a refund.

I understand your frustration. Let me pull up your account. I do need to be upfront about our updated return policy for wearable electronics. For reasons of hygiene and sanitation, there are strict time limits.
What are you talking about? A policy? Don't you dare tell me it's too late! I just got this thing! This is ridiculous!
I apologize, sir. Let me check the exact delivery date on your order to confirm... one moment... Okay, I have your order right here.
Yeah, you better. If you don't give me my money back, I'll be posting on every review site and social media platform about this scam.

My apologies for the confusion. I was referencing a new policy that doesn't apply to your product. I can see you received the VeloBand GPS Tracker just five days ago. Your purchase is well within our 90-day standard return window. I can absolutely process this return for you immediately.
Oh. Ninety days? Well, why didn't you just say that in the first place instead of giving me a lecture about hygiene?

You are correct, I should have confirmed your order details first. My mistake. I've just sent a pre-paid return label to the email address on file. Just print it out, attach it to the box, and drop it off. Once our warehouse receives it, a full refund will be issued to your original payment method.
Fine. Okay. As long as I'm getting my money back. I have the email.
Excellent. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
Alright. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
